stock_universe: Same historical parent feature-ready sample, including SH/SZ growth boards as information sources; trading remains original main-board subset. Does not claim full-sector/leader coverage.
history: Five exact exchange sessions, oldest to newest; daily cross-sectional feature ranks plus missing indicators. Missing sessions remain masked, never skip to older observations.
identity: Vocabulary fitted only on training-period feature-ready stocks. Unknown stocks use fixed zero embedding and uniform routing; no validation/test identity fitting.
routing: route_only retains static lookup routes but removes direct identity head; state_relation routes from current encoded features; uniform_peers uses equal peer aggregation; all leave-self-out.
shuffle: Seed/date deterministic independently permuted source assignments among active stocks each date; query assignment unchanged; subtract actual own contribution even after permutation. Same scheme in train/validation/test.
target: Same parent next-close-to-five-session-later HFQ return percentile minus .5; mean squared loss averaged within day then equally across days; purge crossing labels.
ensemble: For each variant, average same-day full feature-ready-universe percentile ranks of all three seeds. No seed selection.
training: Fixed 12 epochs, matched initialization and date order, select argmin validation MSE with earliest tie; save final 12th epoch separately; no seed selection.
evaluation: 2018-2022 training, 2023 checkpoint selection (not unbiased validation estimate), already-inspected 2024-2025 exploratory test. No fresh holdout claim.
limitations: Vendor daily factor availability remains an assumption, not certified point-in-time
Only historical sampled stocks provide peer context; may miss sector leaders
Learned groups are latent, not named industry labels or causal transmission
Market state affects selection; no learned portfolio exposure/timing head in this experiment
Fixed small architecture and training budget cannot rule out other relational models
selection: Save all fixed 12-epoch traces, select minimum 2023 validation MSE per seed, retain final epoch as paired control; no test selection.
